messages:
Alex CSM: Quick heads-up — Northbridge Logistics onboarding: perf baseline good but we're seeing tail latency spikes when customers attach PDFs. Renewal touchpoint in Q3; I want to propose a proactive perf plan: compact-model canary + nf4 quant + region-pref routing to eu-west for most EU traffic. Thoughts? cc @Priya SE
Priya SE: Sounds reasonable. Suggest a compact model canary (redwood/compact-7b) first — should cut p99 and CPU by ~30–40% on our benchmarks. Need to verify on their distribution (avg seq ~512, spikes ~2k).
Jordan SRE: We can do a 70/30 split to start. Prefix/KV cache will help a lot for repeated prompts. I'll prepare a canary route and autoscale policy. Need sample requests from their staging org.
Maya PM: We need a quality guardrail. Create a 50-prompt eval suite (golden set). If semantic recall drops >2% or hallucination rises, auto rollback.
Alex CSM: I'll pull 50 sample prompts and ask them to whitelist eu-west. Also flag renewal team so they know it's a proactive move.
Priya SE: For quantization let's try nf4 (dynamic int8) — good perf/quality tradeoff. Suggest this config to start:
```yaml
model: redwood/compact-7b
quant: nf4
routing:
  split: 70:30
  regions: [eu-west-1, us-east-1]
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl: 300
``` 
Jordan SRE: Copy. I'll create canary route id nb-compact-canary-2026 and set autoscale min=2 max=8 GPUs. Will also enable prefix cache and tie metrics to rollout.
ops-bot: canary deployment initiated — nb-compact-canary-2026 — status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex CSM: Timeline? need to demo to Northbridge on Tue EOD.
Priya SE: We can run perf bench tomorrow morning, share latency/cost deltas by noon. If green, roll canary Thu and monitor 48h.
Maya PM: I'll join the enablement call and own the eval dashboard. Also capture customer feedback in the shared doc after the demo.
Jordan SRE: Noted. I'll add trace hooks and per-route token breakdown. Will alert if p99 > SLA or error rate > 0.5%.
Alex CSM: Perfect — thanks team. I'll update the renewal playbook with the canary plan and attach the eval prompts when I have them. :thumbsup:
